name: HIRYUU
source:
Once upon a time dinosaurs ruled the Earth. However, they were exterminated by a dark sorcerer. That is, except for one...
The single remaining dinosaur has been reincarnated in a human body and plans to revive its friends. awaken the souls of 5 friends that are slumbering within 5 girls.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ036535.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，恐龙统治着地球。然而，一名黑暗巫师将它们灭绝，只有一只幸存下来……这只仅存的恐龙转生成人，并计划复活同伴，让沉睡在五名女孩体内的五位朋友之魂苏醒。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ036535.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
